title: Mexican Roasted Sweet Potatoes
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Mexican dish featuring roasted sweet potatoes, perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: 2. Pierce the sweet potatoes several times with a fork to allow steam to escape.
3. Rub the sweet potatoes with cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper.
4. Place the sweet potatoes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
5. Roast in the preheated oven for 45-50 minutes, or until tender when pierced with a fork.
6. Remove from oven and brush with lime juice.
7. Sprinkle with coriander and serve hot.
